sources.snippet: The model operates as an image-to-image diffusion model within the ComfyUI node-based interface, enabling iterative image refinement and generation workflows. This is not a standalone model but rather a packaging of the original ACE-Step 1.5 architecture optimized for ComfyUI's modular workflow system.
